outcome: One screen that changes with the moment.

views.title: Climate
views.condition: Provide climate inputs to Ramka, or with Ramka 0.17.0 or later leave them to the home's shared inputs (home_inputs); on the Ramka settings dashboard pick up to twenty widgets (temperature, air quality, custom or empty), in any order. With thresholds: climate-air and the shared inputs, each room's comfort range comes from climate-air's helpers.
views.layout: Ramka landscape layout: 1024–1280 × 720–800 CSS px; phone/portrait dashboard not claimed.

views.title: Air quality
views.condition: Provide air inputs (or, with Ramka 0.17.0 or later, the home's shared inputs) and compatible air-quality readings to Ramka; each reading and its limits can be changed on the Ramka settings dashboard. With thresholds: climate-air in Ramka 0.17.0 or later, those limits are climate-air's helpers.
views.layout: Ramka landscape layout: 1024–1280 × 720–800 CSS px; phone/portrait dashboard not claimed.

views.title: Plant care
views.condition: With plants 0.3.0 or later, set plants: discover in Ramka (or list the plants). Up to six plants share a page by default; more turn in pages, the ones that need something first, and with more than four plants a list page of every plant follows. Swipe left or right to turn the pages yourself.
views.layout: Ramka landscape layout: 1024–1280 × 720–800 CSS px; phone/portrait dashboard not claimed.

views.title: Photo slideshow
views.condition: Provide photo_dir and permit the directory in Home Assistant; albums, photos per series and time per photo are set on the Ramka settings dashboard. Swipe left or right for the next or previous photo of the series.
views.layout: Ramka landscape layout: 1024–1280 × 720–800 CSS px; phone/portrait dashboard not claimed.

views.title: Home status
views.condition: Enabled by default; turn it off on the Ramka settings dashboard or with status_page: false.
views.layout: Ramka landscape layout: 1024–1280 × 720–800 CSS px; phone/portrait dashboard not claimed.

views.title: Room controls
views.condition: Tap the tablet, or approach it with Controls on approach switched on; lights, covers and timers appear when configured. With actions in Ramka 0.16.0 or later, one-tap shortcuts to a button, script or scene, such as a gate remote's, sit under the awnings, each behind Home Assistant's confirmation unless it sets confirm: false.
views.layout: Ramka landscape layout: 1024–1280 × 720–800 CSS px; phone/portrait dashboard not claimed.

views.title: Floor plan on the wall
views.condition: Set floorplan: true in Ramka 0.10.0 or later with the floorplan dashboard pushed; a sideways swipe on the controls shows the plan and back. floorplan_layers lists its layers, one shown at a time; with floorplan 0.3.0 and Ramka 0.11.0 the plants, climate and light layers have maps, now or the last 24 hours, and the plan fills the screen.
views.layout: Ramka landscape layout: 1024–1280 × 720–800 CSS px; phone/portrait dashboard not claimed.

views.title: Now playing
views.condition: A configured media player is playing. With audio-sensor, music_visual set and Live visualization switched on in the settings, the wave strip draws the room's spectrum or level instead of the classic wave.
views.layout: Ramka landscape layout: 1024–1280 × 720–800 CSS px; phone/portrait dashboard not claimed.

views.title: Calendar agenda
views.condition: Configure calendar entities and open the agenda.
views.layout: Ramka landscape layout: 1024–1280 × 720–800 CSS px; phone/portrait dashboard not claimed.

views.title: Clock & weather
views.condition: Provide the weather entity to Ramka, or with Ramka 0.17.0 or later name it in the home's shared inputs. Current weather appears with now playing; the configured climate page also includes a four-day forecast.
views.layout: Ramka landscape layout: 1024–1280 × 720–800 CSS px; phone/portrait dashboard not claimed.

setup: Set up the tablet and Companion app using the tablet guide.
Install the radar through Room presence and map its presence and distance entities.

Choose the optional page inputs, render the dashboard and check each configured page before deployment. From 0.17.0, what the Ramka's file leaves out (lights, climate, outside, air, weather, covers, status contacts and locks) comes from the home's shared inputs, and a panel works without a media player or calendars.

Add the lovelace entries of the Ramka settings dashboard and the Ramka preview dashboard (one tab per screen); pages, presence, controls, display, photos, air limits and colours, climate widgets, plants per page and the music visual are tuned on the settings dashboard live, without a render.

On the tablet: tap to show the controls, swipe up or down for the next or previous page, swipe left or right through a page's plant pages or photos, and tap the bottom-right corner to pause the rotation (a play button resumes it).

states.detail: The configured ambient pages rotate while someone is present.

states.label: Approach
states.headline: Controls within reach
states.detail: A nearby radar detection brings up controls when near controls are enabled.

states.label: Playing
states.headline: Let the music take the screen
states.detail: A playing media player takes priority over the ambient pages.

states.label: Away
states.headline: Rest until you return
states.detail: The tablet sleeps after the configured absence delay; this example skips the wait.
